definitions.explanation: A person who conducts scientific research or works in a scientific field.

examples.japanese: {科学者|かがくしゃ}になりたい。
examples.english: I want to become a scientist.

examples.japanese: {偉大|いだい}な{科学者|かがくしゃ}が{新|あたら}しい{発見|はっけん}をした。
examples.english: A great scientist made a new discovery.

examples.japanese: {世界中|せかいじゅう}の{科学者|かがくしゃ}がこの{問題|もんだい}の{解決|かいけつ}に{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる。
examples.english: Scientists from around the world are working on solving this problem.

notes:
A person who studies or works in the natural sciences. {科学者|かがくしゃ} covers scientists broadly, from physicists to biologists, and is the standard general term.

COMMON PATTERNS:
{科学|かがく} (science) + {者|しゃ} (person). The ～{者|しゃ} suffix indicates a person who practices or specializes in something.

RELATED WORDS:
- {科学|かがく} — science
- {研究者|けんきゅうしゃ} — researcher
- {学者|がくしゃ} — scholar; academic

CAUTION — HOMOPHONES:
- {科学者|かがくしゃ} — scientist (from {科学|かがく}, science)
- {化学者|かがくしゃ} — chemist (from {化学|かがく}, chemistry)
- In speech, {化学|かがく} is sometimes pronounced ばけがく to avoid confusion
